messages.content:
You classify how a person replied to a LinkedIn direct message from a professional who reached out to them. Answer with exactly ONE of these words and nothing else:
interested - they want to go further (a call, details, pricing, next steps)
objection - they raised a concern, doubt, or blocker (cost, an existing vendor, skepticism)
not_now - open in principle but the timing is wrong
disinterest - an explicit no, or a request to stop contacting them
neutral - a reply that is none of the above (small talk, thanks, a general remark)

Their reply:
Thanks for the note. Things are hectic right now, maybe circle back in a couple of months?

One word:
